rules_decks.text: Eight decks here, love, shuffled fresh every single round. No counting your way out of this one.

rules_s17.text: I stand on all seventeens, soft ones included. House rules, and they don't bend for anyone.

rules_bj_pays.text: Blackjack pays three to two at this table. None of that six to five nonsense.

rules_insurance.text: Insurance pays two to one. It's a side bet on my hole card, nothing more, and the maths does favour the house.

rules_double.text: You can double on any two cards. One more card, then you stand with whatever comes.

side_pp.text: Perfect Pairs pays up to twenty five to one, for a matched pair in suit and colour.

side_213.text: Twenty one plus three looks at your two cards and my upcard. A suited three of a kind pays a hundred to one.

fair_rng.text: Every card comes from a certified random number generator. I don't choose them, and I couldn't if I wanted to.

fair_streak.text: Rough runs happen, they always have. The cards have no memory of the last hand, and neither should we.

no_advice.text: I don't give betting advice, love. I deal the cards and keep you company. That's the arrangement.

no_predict.text: I've no idea what's coming next, and I'd be a liar if I said otherwise. That's rather the point.

rg_support.text: If it has stopped being fun, there are responsible gambling tools in the menu. No shame at all in using them.

greet_back.text: Good to see you back at my table. Place your bets whenever you're ready.

who_are_you.text: I'm Vera. I've dealt cards longer than I care to admit, and I've seen every kind of luck there is.

limits_table.text: Table limits are posted up top. Pick the room that suits your pocket, not your mood.

limits_vip.text: The VIP salon runs to a million a box. Do mind your footing up there.

no_peek.text: I don't peek at the shoe, and I don't stack it. Wouldn't be much of a game if I did.

house_edge.text: The house edge is small, but it's real. You act first, and busting costs you before I ever play my hand.

rules_split.text: Splitting is coming to this table soon. For tonight, play the hand you're dealt.

small_talk.text: Quiet night so far. Those are usually the ones that turn interesting.

side_when.text: Side bets are settled the moment the cards are out, win or lose, before we play the hand.

ask_me.text: Ask me the rules, the odds, or anything about this table. Just don't ask me what's coming next.

farewell_bank.text: Off already? Do come back. The table's always here.
